docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A textbook of trigonometry: angle measure, the sine, cosine and tangent and their graphs, the identities, the solution of triangles by the laws of sines and cosines, the inverse functions and complex numbers, with examples and exercises.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

Trigonometry, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
